rationale: TLK has gapped up 8.13% with no news catalyst identified, which creates significant uncertainty about the driver and sustainability of the move. Price is at 98.6% of today's range, essentially at the session high, with very tight 1-minute candles showing stalling momentum and low volume on recent bars — the last spike to $11.62 high was not sustained. Entering long at the top of a large unexplained gap with no pullback and no clear continuation signal carries poor risk/reward, while shorting into a strong gap-up with no confirmed reversal structure is equally unattractive.
